caption: The drawing depicts a single pitcher with a curved spout and a large, rounded body. The pitcher has a pronounced handle attached vertically from the neck to the midsection, colored in a light gray tone. The body of the pitcher is decorated with alternating and blending shades of yellow and purple, with the colors distributed in an irregular, organic pattern that flows vertically and horizontally. The surface of the pitcher also features horizontal lines, appearing like ribbed texture, covering the entire body except for the handle. The base of the pitcher is a simple circular foot, also rendered in gray. The background is plain and uncolored, focusing attention on the pitcher itself.
title: Glass Water Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
